description: This file contains functions and constants for reading, resolving, and processing TypeScript configuration files (`tsconfig.json`) for the `ts-node` project, including handling of compiler options, configuration inheritance, and default settings.

methods.name: fixConfig
methods.description: Post-processes TypeScript compiler options to set defaults and remove unsupported options for `ts-node`.

methods.name: findAndReadConfig
methods.description: Reads and merges TypeScript configuration files and options based on provided raw options.

methods.name: readConfig
methods.description: Loads and parses `tsconfig.json` files, handling inheritance and merging options from various sources.

methods.name: resolveAndLoadCompiler
methods.description: Resolves and loads the TypeScript compiler module based on a name and path.

methods.name: resolveCompiler
methods.description: Resolves the compiler module path relative to a given directory.

methods.name: loadCompiler
methods.description: Attempts to require and cache the compiler module.

methods.name: filterRecognizedTsConfigTsNodeOptions
methods.description: Filters and extracts recognized `ts-node` options from a raw JSON object.

methods.name: getTsConfigDefaults
methods.description: Computes default values for certain TypeScript compiler options not set in `tsconfig.json`.
